page.layout: One title page: centred title block in capitals and italics, with a woodcut device (a tree and a figure, with the motto banner "NON SOLUS") between the subtitle and the imprint. Imprint centred at the foot.
page.notes: Woodcut device between the subtitle and the imprint: a tree with a figure beside it and the banner "NON SOLUS" wound with two serpents; not transcribed as text, only the banner words are printed. Left edge shows cut-off fragments of the neighbouring page and show-through, which are left out. Date copied from the reversed-C numerals: cIↄ Iↄ c XXXII = MDCXXXII. The initial "V" of "UBBONIS" and "RESPVBLICÆ" is printed as V and is changed to U as capital u.
